data_mode: firecrawl web path (PitchAPI not connected): ESPN match + team stats, BBC match page. No Opta-style player ratings; ratings are BBC reporter marks (out of 10) and BBC user averages, labelled as such. Best/worst are Scout's pick.
headline: Roma led 2-0 after 17 minutes and never had a shot in the second half; United went from 5 shots before the break to 10 after it, and ended a nine-game winless run.

team_story.label: Shots by half (United)
team_story.why_it_matters: United doubled their shot count after the break: 5 in the first half, 10 in the second, including all three goals.
team_story.source: derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json = https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401915308/as-roma-manchester-united shot map; totals 15 match ESPN team stats https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401915308 'Shots'

team_story.label: Shots by half (Roma)
team_story.why_it_matters: All 7 Roma shots came before half-time (both goals in the first 17 minutes); none after.
team_story.source: derived.json (analysis.py) from shots_espn.json; Roma total 7 matches https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401915308 'Shots'

team_story.label: xG
team_story.why_it_matters: The side that trailed 2-0 created almost twice Roma's expected goals over the 90.
team_story.source: https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401915308/as-roma-manchester-united Team Stats 'Expected Goals' (cache data/research/scrape_881f32ddbd18.json); BBC Basic Stats xG 2.72 v 1.53 (cache data/research/scrape_6349c0a71541.json)

team_story.label: Touches in opposition box
team_story.why_it_matters: United lived in Roma's box; Roma barely reached theirs.
team_story.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmj47pveql18t Basic Stats 'Total touches inside the opposition box' (cache data/research/scrape_6349c0a71541.json)

tactical_change.after: 4-2-3-1 (shape unchanged in source); Cunha moved inside, Mbeumo wide left
tactical_change.trigger: Half-time talk plus Baleba's hamstring injury: Tielemans on for Baleba (BBC lineup: 51 minutes; BBC rating text says 50)
tactical_change.effect: United went from 5 shots to 10 and from 0 goals to 3; Roma went from 7 shots to 0.
tactical_change.quote: Carrick: 'We moved Matheus inside second half and put Bryan [Mbeumo] wide left to give us better balance.' (BBC https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmj47pveql18t, manager quotes)
tactical_change.confidence: medium (formation after the changes is not stated by the sources; Roma's own half-time sub, Pisilli for Mora at 46, is in the BBC lineup)

best_player.name: Matheus Cunha
best_player.rating_note: BBC reporter mark 8/10; BBC user average 7.72 (player of the match)
best_player.why: Two goals in three minutes (83' and 86') turned 2-2 into 3-2 after he forced the penalty that started the comeback; sent off for a second yellow at 90+1.
best_player.source: xG and shots from derived.json (ESPN shot map https://www.espn.co.uk/football/match/_/gameId/401915308/as-roma-manchester-united); goals ESPN header; rating and 'forced a penalty' from https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmj47pveql18t 'Magnificent Man Utd - how they rated' and Player of the match

worst_player.name: Diogo Dalot
worst_player.rating_note: BBC user average 4.55, lowest of any player listed for either team; BBC reporter mark 5/10
worst_player.why: BBC: caught way out of position when United lost the ball in midfield for Soule's goal, and again for the second. Played all 90.
worst_player.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmj47pveql18t how they rated (Dalot, 5) and Player of the match ratings; shots and xG from derived.json (ESPN shot map)

surprise_stat.label: Roma shots before half-time vs after

Fernandes' penalty was retaken after a Roma player entered the area; he scored at 58' (0.79 xG).

context.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cmj47pveql18t match report; ESPN team stats 'Hit Woodwork' 1 each

caveats: No player ratings from a data provider: ratings are BBC reporter marks and BBC user averages (labelled). Best/worst are Scout's pick.
Shot-map xG sums to 2.73 (United) and 1.55 (Roma); ESPN/BBC list 2.72 and 1.53. Reel uses 2.72 and 1.53 for totals and shot counts (not half xG) for the half split.
Half split uses the ESPN shot map: first half = 45' and 45'+n shots; 2.48 of United's shot-map xG after the break includes the 0.79 retaken penalty (9 shots / 1.69 xG without it).
Baleba's substitution minute differs inside BBC (50 in rating text, 51 in lineup): avoid an exact minute, say 'just after half-time'.
Formation after the changes is not stated by any source; do not claim a new shape.
ESPN commentary calls the Cunha dismissal 'second yellow'; BBC agrees ('Two Yellow Cards at 90 minutes plus 1').
